entries.text: Hi, it's Sarah from HeliumDeploy. Thanks for taking a few minutes with me: your code, $25 off orders of $100+, shows up on screen as soon as we finish. I see you were looking at the Bugatti Gatsby Carry-On. What caught your eye?
It's for a two week trip to Portugal with my wife in November. We fly Air Transat.

A two-week trip to Portugal with your wife sounds lovely. November should be a nice time to go.

Is a carry-on the only bag you're taking, or are you checking luggage too?
Mostly it has to fit the carry on size limit. And be light. I really hate heavy bags.

Light and carry-on size, got it. Nobody likes hauling a heavy bag around airports.

Besides us, where else have you been looking for a bag, like other stores, brands, or Amazon?
I looked at Samsonite on Amazon and something had cost co. But the Bugatti looks nicer.

Samsonite on Amazon and something at Costco, okay. And the Bugatti looks nicer to you, good to know.

What would make you ready to buy it today, or what's holding you back?
Honestly, I just want to know the exact dimensions. And if shipping is fast enough before the trip,
I don't have the exact dimensions, and I won't guess. The product page lists them, so I'll point you there. The store's policy pages cover shipping times, so check them before November.

Since you fly Air Transat, it's worth comparing those numbers with their carry-on limit before you buy.

If the size works, would anything else hold you back, like price or trust in ordering from us?
I saw an Instagram ad a few days ago. That's how I found you.

An Instagram ad, great, thanks for telling me. Thanks so much for your time and for sharing all that. Your code will appear on screen as soon as you press "End call". Enjoy Portugal with your wife, goodbye!
No. I think that covers it. Thanks a lot. Bye.
